description: Fund an existing pending_deposit bounty. Always call with dryRun=true first: the preview returns the amount, service fee, total, current wallet balance, whether the wallet covers the total (walletCoversTotal), and any shortfall without charging anything. Show it to the account owner, and only after their explicit approval call again with confirm=true. A confirmed call may reserve available wallet funds immediately. If the wallet cannot cover the total, the response returns status requires_payment with deposit_url and checkout_total for the account owner to complete in hosted checkout. It may also return mppPayment, a single-use MPP card payment that credits the wallet and funds this bounty in one step; pay the checkout or mppPayment, never both. Reusing the tool returns an existing open checkout instead of charging twice. Unknown arguments are rejected. A bounty that is no longer pending_deposit returns 400. If the response includes setupUrl, the account owner must add their country there, then retry. Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the pending_deposit bounty to fund

confirm.description: Must be true to fund. Set it only after showing the dryRun preview to the account owner and receiving their explicit approval.

dryRun.description: true returns a no-charge preview: amount, service fee, total, and current wallet balance. Nothing is reserved, charged, or started.

name: fund_bounty
title: Fund bounty
